home.title: Health Smoothie
home.text: If you want to start your day with a healthy choice, you’re in the right place! Our smoothies, made with natural fruits, superfoods, and a touch of love, will boost your energy and provide your body with the nutrients it needs. Tasty, nutritious, and natural – the most delicious choice for your health!

homeDrink.aboutDrink: Our energy-boosting and vitamin-rich natural drinks are made with fresh, natural fruits. Each order is crafted to fill your body with energy and support your health. Our smoothies are packed with vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Every drink is made with natural sweetness and healthy ingredients, making them the perfect choice for a healthy lifestyle. Refresh your day with the power of fruits!

homeAbout.avocadoText: Avocado is packed with healthy fats and is a great addition to any meal.
homeAbout.appleText: An apple a day not only keeps the doctor away, but adds a crisp sweetness to your drink.
homeAbout.lemonText: Lemon adds a zesty kick and a burst of vitamin C to any infusion.
homeAbout.freshWaterText: Fresh water is the pure foundation that brings all flavors together.

homeBeverage.title: Upcoming Our Beverage
homeBeverage.paragraphOne: Our upcoming beverages are made with fresh fruits, herbs, and natural ingredients to support a healthy lifestyle. Each drink is packed with nutrients and designed to refresh and energize you.
homeBeverage.paragraphTwo: We’re introducing unique flavors with no added sugar or artificial additives. Perfect for any time of day — stay tuned for the launch of your new favorite healthy drink!
